targetTexts.1: But as for you, speak the things that are consistent with sound doctrine.
targetTexts.2: Older men are to be temperate, dignified, self-controlled, and sound in faith, love, and perseverance.
targetTexts.3: Older women, likewise, are to be reverent in their behavior, not slanderers or addicted to much wine, but teachers of good.
targetTexts.4: In this way they can train the young women to love their husbands and children,
targetTexts.5: to be self-controlled, pure, managers of their households, kind, and submissive to their own husbands, so that the word of God will not be discredited.
targetTexts.6: In the same way, urge the younger men to be self-controlled.
targetTexts.7: In everything, show yourself to be an example by doing good works. In your teaching show integrity, dignity,
targetTexts.8: and wholesome speech that is above reproach, so that anyone who opposes us will be ashamed, having nothing bad to say about us.
targetTexts.9: Slaves are to submit to their own masters in everything, to be well-pleasing, not argumentative,
targetTexts.10: not stealing from them, but showing all good faith, so that in every respect they will adorn the teaching about God our Savior.
targetTexts.11: For the grace of God has appeared, bringing salvation to everyone.
targetTexts.12: It instructs us to renounce ungodliness and worldly passions, and to live sensible, upright, and godly lives in the present age,
targetTexts.13: as we await the blessed hope and glorious appearance of our great God and Savior Jesus Christ.
targetTexts.14: He gave Himself for us to redeem us from all lawlessness and to purify for Himself a people for His own possession, zealous for good deeds.
targetTexts.15: Speak these things as you encourage and rebuke with all authority. Let no one despise you.
